Project Management for Real Life: Entrepreneurial Edition™

Self-Paced Program Learn the PMFRL Methodology™

This isn’t a masterclass.

It isn’t a motivational seminar.

And it certainly isn’t inspiration disguised as strategy.

Project Management for Real Life: Entrepreneurial Edition™ is your introduction to The PMFRL Methodology™—the proprietary intellectual property created by Kenya Young and the signature framework through which the empowerHER Legacy Institute for Entrepreneurship Excellence equips entrepreneurs to build with clarity, structure and intention.

The Problem

Too Many Women Are Building Backwards.

Working harder. Doing more. Carrying everything.

Yet wondering why progress still feels out of reach.

Not because they lack ambition. Not because they lack intelligence.

Because they’re building without a framework. Without a strategy. Without systems capable of supporting the future they’re trying to create.

Money gets wasted. Time gets consumed. Momentum disappears. Great ideas collapse beneath the weight of daily life.

Not because the vision was wrong—

Because the structure never existed to support it.

The PMFRL Methodology™ was created to change that.

The Origin

A Methodology Born in the Boardroom. Proven in Real Life.

Kenya Young, PMP

The PMFRL Methodology™ wasn’t developed inside a classroom. It emerged through nearly three decades of leading enterprise initiatives, building businesses and managing high-impact projects where strategy, execution and accountability determined success.

As a Project Management Professional (PMP), Kenya Young spent her career helping organizations transform complex ideas into measurable results.

Then life required something even greater. It required her to rebuild her own.

The same systems she once used to launch initiatives, lead teams and execute complex projects became the framework she relied upon to navigate uncertainty, rebuild with intention and create a new future. That experience transformed project management from a professional discipline into a life methodology.

Today, the PMFRL Methodology™ remains the proprietary intellectual property of its creator while serving as the educational foundation upon which every curriculum, certification and learning experience offered through the empowerHER Legacy Institute is built.

Kenya doesn’t simply teach the methodology.
She builds with it. She leads with it. She lives it.
Every day.

The PMFRL Methodology™

The PMFRL Methodology™ is the proprietary intellectual property of Kenya Young and the signature framework taught through the empowerHER Legacy Institute for Entrepreneurship Excellence. Every Institute curriculum, certification and educational experience is built upon its principles—ensuring a consistent, practical approach to building businesses and lives with greater clarity, structure and intention.

The PMFRL Methodology™ isn’t about becoming a project manager. It’s about learning to think like one.Because entrepreneurship shouldn’t feel like survival. It should feel sustainable.

Who This Is For

Who the PMFRL Methodology™ Was Designed For

This methodology was created for the woman who…

  • Is finished chasing hustle without direction.
  • Has a vision but needs a framework.
  • Wants strategy—not more motivation.
  • Is tired of trying to piece everything together alone.
  • Wants to build a business that complements her life instead of competing with it.
  • Values structure as much as creativity.
  • Believes success should never require sacrificing who she is.
  • Knows she wasn’t built for smallness.

She was built for legacy.

Experience the Program

Experience the PMFRL Program

The PMFRL Program is the flagship learning experience through which you’ll learn, apply and master the PMFRL Methodology™.

The PMFRL Coursebook + Strategic Planning Journal
A beautifully designed companion that integrates guided instruction, strategic planning and practical implementation into one cohesive system. More than a workbook. More than a planner. Your blueprint for execution.
Comprehensive Learning Modules
Self-paced video and audio instruction that teaches you how to confidently apply the PMFRL Methodology™ to your own entrepreneurial journey.
ProjectME™ Launch Planner
Exclusive implementation tools including Work Breakdown Structures, Gantt planning systems and execution resources designed to move your vision from concept to completion. Because vision deserves a plan.
Templates, Frameworks & Business Resources
Practical implementation tools, startup guidance, business templates and foundational resources designed for entrepreneurs building in the real world.
Lifetime Access
As the PMFRL Methodology™ continues to evolve, your learning evolves with it. Your enrollment includes future curriculum enhancements and updates.

Because vision deserves a plan.

The Credential

Earn the CEPS Designation

The designation represents more than completing a program. It represents mastering a methodology that will continue serving you long after the course is complete.

Because confidence isn’t built through inspiration.
It’s built through preparation.
